finish.summary: Built 3-cell linear rack (piece:-1,0,0;full, piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full) bolted with jointBolts and capped ends. Rear has 3 keyhole hangers for wall mounting, front has 5 hook accessories for small hand tools. Configurator restricts hook props to tape/coil/goggles only, so real pliers/screwdrivers hang in use but not shown as props; build geometry correctly provides hooks.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Your wall-hung tool rack is on the bench — I'll get it set up with keyhole hangers and tool hooks.
